content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines downloadable files as part of static files, media, and file storage. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
content_blocks.text: The source syllabus for this lesson names: FileResponse; Download headers; Streaming large files; Access-controlled downloads; Range and delivery considerations. Keep these distinct concepts together: know what each item does, when it applies, and what assumption must be verified in your project.
